metadataParity.reason: Authorized live foreground-blur correction changes the gamesRail source fingerprint. Blender does not consume foregroundBlur.
metadataParity.proof: Deep equality passed after removing only revision/calibration/source-hash metadata and foregroundBlur. All camera/background DOF/bokeh, foreground transforms/opacity, samples, impacts, color and dimensions remain identical. Exact exported eyewear positions and indices also match.

protected.sourceAssets: existing original and licensed assets only; source manifest unchanged

previewApproval: Root visual review approved corrected trails, retained early fire, late cooling and small static details before bulk rendering.
masterReuse: Three exact approved preview PNGs reused as frame masters with SHA256 proof in optimization-reused-previews.json; all other frames and eight posters rendered from the same source.

peakAreaCheck.warmPredicate: R > 180 && G > 90 && R > 1.15 * B, display-referred 8-bit PNG RGB
peakAreaCheck.limitation: Heuristic baseline comparison only; not perceptual impact, registered lens occupancy, lawful-reference parity or photographic approval.

checksPassed: trail endpoints match actual existing SUV contacts; finite sampled coordinates
asset self-test and existing f410 byte/dimension/content-revision verification
frame parity and seven-viewport lens registration

delivery.installation: Verified staging directory installed as a matching directory pair while all Games browser readers were closed. Previous complete directory preserved; independent public verify passed after installation.
checks: public content-revision, dimensions, hashes and byte-budget verification

renderMeasurements.limitation: Measured offline render wall durations, not browser FPS or guaranteed future render rates. Exploratory and rejected preview renders are excluded.

limitations: Original deterministic procedural volume shading, not baked gas simulation.
Hand anatomy/contact and reference-based color gates require human review.
No new reference imagery, public film assets, paid services, dependencies or deployment.
